method: Metrics independently derived from the 576 raw native reports; exact two-sided sign enumeration across 12 block effects; Holm adjustment within each cohort/phase family of 12; 24 within-side control drifts per row. Existing comparison and cohort auditor receipts were checked as independent oracles.
limitations: Audit establishes byte custody and arithmetic consistency only. Quiet CPU windows were not verified, selected process lists are not exhaustive, and this audit does not establish causal attribution, policy acceptance or cross-cohort gain.
